scientific_integrity: The stated finite witness and interval inequality checks are exhaustive within their explicit domains; no inference to unrestricted wildfire scenarios or independent scientific certification is made.
scientific_limitations: The exact result is restricted to homogeneous one-dimensional cells with independent ignitions, perfect firebreaks, complete within-segment spread, 3..21 cells for the sharp canonical-stage cutoff, and a bounded q-window for the exact two-winner switch. Does not model field wildfire management.
title: Twenty-one cells are the sharp first skipped allocation stage for three wildfire compartments
